brief: The CZ payments-employer source landscape splits into three usable layers: company-owned channels (Global Payments CZ, Worldline en-cz, Nexi Central Europe, GoPay's dedicated jobs subdomain, Twisto's 'pro média'), Czech-language trade and business media that actually run appointment columns (fintag.cz 'Personálie', ProfitOnline 'Lidé a společnost', Fintree, FinTech Cowboys, CzechCrunch, Lupa, E15, plus ČTK's Protext wire as the PR backbone), and structural registries (ČNB JERRS/open data for the actor universe, obchodní rejstřík statutory-body changes as the hardest dateable proxy for country-manager churn). LinkedIn is the richest single newsroom for GoPay and Comgate but is login-walled and ToS-restricted, so it must stay a manual-review source. The weakest coverage is the terminal/ATM estate — Euronet, Diebold Nixdorf and NCR/Atos country teams publish essentially nothing in Czech — and card-scheme CZ offices, both of which should be picked up via register monitoring and a dedicated scheme-focused pass. Local-language searching was decisive: the highest-value finds (Protext, fintag Personálie, Twisto and Skip Pay appointment PR) surfaced only on cs queries, not en ones.
